Linked secondary device.
HTTP bound to 127.0.0.1:8080 only.
Sends and receives as the account.

Agent gateway (Signal channel)
Narrowed toolset: no browser, no code
execution, no scheduler, no delegation.
Denies unknown senders by default.

div.span:
Note:
✔️ The workstation attaches to Signal as a linked secondary device, so the daemon binds to loopback alone and the phone stays primary.
✔️ The Signal channel runs a deliberately narrowed toolset. Retaining the terminal, however, lets the agent reach the hermes send CLI and message any contact, which restores the very capability the framework withholds from the agent loop; the trade is made knowingly, not by accident.
✔️ The daemon writes message bodies to the system journal in clear text, mitigated with --scrub-log. Access control (allow-list of one number, groups ignored) is the single control standing between an inbound message and a shell, so it is load-bearing rather than optional.
